scroll-edge.$description: The amounts of the scroll edge — the mark at an edge of a box that scrolls while content lies beyond it (sys.behavior.scroll-edge chooses its kind). Every edge that draws one reads these, so a band is as deep at the top of a list as at the bottom of a form.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product draws every scroll edge to one measure: a band that sinks a list into its surface 24 deep at the top and a form's 40 deep beside it read as two hands. The amounts belong to the product, not to each box; a design system that wants one component apart sets that component's token.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: The depth of the shadow and fade bands, and the depth, strength and steps of the blur band. A component reads them through its own tokens (comp.scroll-area.*), which alias them.
rules: The shadow's color is not here: it is the color of the surface the box stands on, which the component names (comp.scroll-area.shadow.color). A fixed shadow color would show as a dark smear on a light surface and a light one on a dark surface.
Keep blur.radius at 10 or less: a larger radius costs more to draw in every frame of a scroll and muddies the band.
blur.layers times the band's area is the cost of drawing a blur; a screen should not hold more than two blurred edges.

extent.$description: How deep the shadow and fade bands reach in from their edge: full at the edge, none at this depth.
How deep the blur band reaches in from its edge.

radius.$description: The blur's radius at the edge; it falls in even steps to none at the band's inner end.

layers.$description: In how many layers of evenly stepped radius the blur band is drawn, each masked to its part of the band so that no step shows.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A count of drawing steps, chosen for the cost of drawing; no dial scales it.
